statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.printify_orders (order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES public.orders (order_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, stripe_checkout_session_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (char_length(stripe_checkout_session_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 255), printify_order_id TEXT UNIQUE, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (state IN ('pending','submitting','submitted','in_production','shipped','delivered','canceled','needs_attention')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempts >= 0), claim_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, last_error_code TEXT, submitted_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_printify_orders_due ON public.printify_orders (state, claim_expires_at) WHERE state IN ('pending','submitting','submitted')
